# Sundae Symphony

Sundae Symphony is a responsive ice cream parlour portfolio website built using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript. The website showcases premium ice creams, sundaes, special offers, customer reviews, and contact information.

Website
https://renuga140802-star.github.io/Sunday-Funday-Parlour/

## Main Pages
- Home
  https://renuga140802-star.github.io/Sunday-Funday-Parlour/

- Products
  https://renuga140802-star.github.io/Sunday-Funday-Parlour/product.html

- Reviews
  https://renuga140802-star.github.io/Sunday-Funday-Parlour/reviews.html

- Contact
  https://renuga140802-star.github.io/Sunday-Funday-Parlour/contact.html

## Featured Products
- Chocolate Heaven
- Strawberry Bliss
- Mango Magic
- Premium Sundaes
- Seasonal Ice Creams

## Website Features
- Responsive design
- Bootstrap framework
- Mobile-friendly layout
- Customer reviews
- Contact page
- Special offers

## Technologies
- HTML5
- CSS3
- Bootstrap 5
- JavaScript

## Purpose
This website was created as a front-end web development portfolio project to demonstrate responsive web design and UI development skills.
